notes: Ubuntu v1.1.53: GUI-only simplification built directly on v1.1.52. Live theme selection is removed from Settings and Ubuntu is forced to the Gold theme at every launch, ignoring any old saved theme preference. This removes the theme-selection flicker while keeping the existing stable embedded Settings/report dialogs. Existing workflow, speeds, timers, reporting, activation, pairing, queue logic, and Ubuntu 20-50 tab limit are unchanged.
